authority.approved_proposal: Prioritize production pool; explicitly bound subset degradation; retain original contract outcomes; compare retained C and the existing state-sparse candidate; modify causal holding/risk mechanisms only when needed; verify one source before normal PR101 merge.

original.role: Original wealth denominator and original-return/add-one protections. The historical qualification reference uses these same file bytes; this equality was verified, not assumed.

incumbent.role: Separate incumbent promotion protections; accepted with historical exceptions, not a replacement original denominator.

comparators.B1: Scientific correctness control only; not an acceptance denominator

formal.execution_semantics: Existing close-known signals, next executable open, original board limits/T+1/ADV/fee/lot/account-state rules; planned sells never count as fills.
formal.guard_semantics: The guards named in this inherited formal block are reported in full; changed_gates/new_wealth_gates/retained_gates above define the effective production-primary acceptance.

changed_gates.original_reference_prefix_wealth: Report all 17 original ratios and failures as diagnostics; no original-reference prefix wealth gate in new acceptance.
changed_gates.incumbent_fixed_prefix_wealth: Replace every-prefix >=0.99 by production prefix-17 >=0.99 plus uniformly paired family wealth gates.
changed_gates.adjacent_prefix_wealth: Report all 16 actual ratios, including strict 09->10 original failure; no adjacent-ratio gate in new acceptance.
changed_gates.incumbent_maximum_turnover: Remove incumbent worst bucket+10 cap (currently230); the uniform authorized238 maximum is the effective maximum. Original comparison remains diagnostic.

new_wealth_gates.formula: (1 + candidate.total_return)/(1 + pinned_incumbent.total_return), paired by exact scenario ID, type and ordered symbols
new_wealth_gates.quantiles: Existing stress_metrics._quantile linear interpolation, evaluated separately within each of the five families; no pooling or optional family.
new_wealth_gates.rationale: Production economics have priority. The median scenario in every family must retain incumbent wealth; lower-decile deterioration is bounded at 10%, with a 30% absolute paired terminal-wealth loss ceiling. These are explicit policy choices, not estimates of future safety or scientifically optimal constants.
new_wealth_gates.lost_protection: No guarantee of retaining 99%/95% of the original reference per prefix or 99% of the incumbent per prefix. Up to 30% paired terminal-wealth loss is allowed in an individual stress case. Adding a symbol may reduce wealth by more than the old adjacent limits; all such cliffs must remain visible.

retained_gates: all 958 max drawdown <=18% with existing machine tolerance
random bucket P90 <=160 and all bucket max <=238
original-reference worst total return and worst add-one deterioration bounds
all existing incumbent promotion checks other than fixed_prefix_wealth_at_least_99pct and all_worst_date_symbol_side_buckets_not_increased
exact permutation invariance, real account ownership/cash/fees/ADV/lot/T+1/limits and persistent risk history
locked environment, source/data/config binding, complete formal scenario coverage, qualification and real repository protections

selection.historical_visibility: Existing diagnostic outcomes have already been viewed. This is a disclosed acceptance redesign and reuse of failed original-contract candidates, not unseen validation or a claim of original success.
selection.reuse: Recover hashes/source identities. Reuse existing compatible rows. Fill missing prefixes first; then LOO/add-one and a bounded preregistered random risk screen. Full958 only for a stable candidate without known necessary failures.
selection.ranking: Among candidates surviving necessary gates, prefer higher production prefix-17 wealth, then lower drawdown, then fewer date/symbol/side buckets. New core changes require event-level cause and protected paths.

external_diagnostics.first_remote_record: After initial A/B diagnosis; before any external evaluation or final candidate selection
pools: All 17 ordered production symbols at base_main_revision
limitations: 2024 data and related pools have been observed historically; these are outside the formal window, not guaranteed unseen.
No external results used for this batch selection. Further tuning after exposure must disclose holdout reuse.
Formal 958 and new seeds on the same series do not establish market generalization.

implementation.preserve_legacy: Keep original gate implementations and outputs intact. Native publication must recompute the new contract and retain separate original-contract results; no waiver or forged pass on legacy checks. Update documentation/tests and semantic goldens only after independent result verification.

no_further_threshold_adjustment: Do not tune this contract against the new results. Failures call for source improvements, a separately justified direction, or a truthful blocker, not automatic relaxation.
